verdict.rationale: The full engine source is public on GitHub and can be cloned directly (threejs-gh-2). A runtime probe verified the MIT license from the npm registry (threejs-probe-rt-1), which permits reading, modifying and redistributing the engine. The repo also notes addon renderers ship as source alongside the core builds (threejs-gh-3). Missing for 10: no documented guide in the pack for building or patching a modified engine from source, and no hands-on report of a developer forking the engine to get past a limitation.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can read and modify the full engine source when I hit a wall

citations.quote: MIT license verified from the registry.
SVG and CSS3D renderers are also available as addons.
